_comment: General-crops plant model — moderate biomass + active soil + glazing. c_eff_mj_per_c is the air-coupled effective heat capacity (air + soil surface + crop biomass + glazing) in MJ/degC; it sets the thermal-lag time constant via tau_T = c_eff / (ACH * V * rho * cp). 30 MJ/degC ≈ ~10× air mass: typical for a mature general-crop canopy (lettuce/tomato class) with active soil surface.
